start: Workout tab, routines list with three routines

steps.action: Press and hold a routine card for about a third of a second
user_sees: The card lifts and follows the finger
must_not: A plain tap lifting the card

steps.action: Drag it past another card and let go
user_sees: A light buzz as it passes; the new order stays after reopening the app

steps.action: Hold the exercise name row and drag it down two places
user_sees: Every card shrinks to its name row while held; on release the exercise sits in its new place
must_not: Holding a weight box lifting the card

steps.action: Scroll the list quickly with a finger on a card
user_sees: The list scrolls; no card lifts
must_not: A card lifting during a scroll

steps.action: Start a drag, then let another gesture take over (a system swipe)
user_sees: Nothing moves; the card goes back

steps.action: Use the card's ⋯ menu Move up to undo the move
user_sees: The card goes back up one place
must_not: Move up missing for screen reader users
